ImageDescription.value:
Name: Tel Fachar, Golan Heights
Description: Tel Fachar is a commemorative site for the martyrs of the IDF who fell during the occupation of the place in the Six Day War and for the martyrs of the 12th Battalion of the Golani Brigade. Canals and bunkers of the Syrian outpost have been preserved on the site and you can look towards the Hula Valley and the Naftali Mountains. Signs and audio systems tell the story of the battle and bring the stories of the warriors

ImageDescription.value:
Name: Tel Fachar, Golan Heights
Description: Tel Fachar is a commemorative site for the martyrs of the IDF who fell during the occupation of the place in the Six Day War and for the martyrs of the 12th Battalion of the Golani Brigade. Canals and bunkers of the Syrian outpost have been preserved on the site and you can look towards the Hula Valley and the Naftali Mountains. Signs and audio systems tell the story of the battle and bring the stories of the warriors
